text: すべての　わざを　たくして　きが　すんだら　なんだか　すこし　わかがえって　しまった　ようじゃ…

structure.jp: すべての　わざを　たくして
structure.en: having entrusted all my moves, and
now that I feel at ease

structure.jp: わかがえって　しまった　ようじゃ…
structure.en: I seem to have grown younger...

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.span: わかがえって　しまった
patterns.explanation: しまう after a て-form says the thing went and happened completely, often without meaning it to. わかがえって　しまった = 'I've gone and grown younger'.

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.explanation: ようだ after a sentence says 'it seems that'. じゃ is the old-man だ. わかがえって　しまった　ようじゃ = 'it seems I've grown younger'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'when' or 'once' that happened, and then tells what followed. きが　すんだら = 'once I felt at ease'.
